freeze_rule: Freeze this new version ONLY after Claude/user review and BEFORE real OHLC performance inspection. Holdout must remain blind, and any post-freeze change requires fresh confirmatory data.
holdout_policy: No OHLC distributions, regime summaries, thresholds, equity plots or decisions for holdout until the development gates are fixed and passed. Dataset integrity / timestamps / listings only. One final test use.

range_detector.canonical_implementation: backend/director/research/range_detector_v2.py freeze_levels/detect_confirmation; full nonoverlapping research scanner not yet implemented
range_detector.frozen_bounds_calculated_from: Last eight hours of FULLY CLOSED bars BEFORE separate qualification window; no in-window refitting
range_detector.qualification_requires: Four alternating confirmed rejections S-R-S-R or R-S-R-S. A touch needs a following completed candle within 2 bars closing >= support+2*tolerance for S, or <= resistance-2*tolerance for R. Two per edge, >=3 bar spacing between same-side confirmations.
range_detector.trend_gate: Last fully closed 1h ADX14<20 as-of end of reference AND abs(last_reference_close-first_reference_close)<=0.5*(frozen_resistance-frozen_support)
range_detector.breakout_invalidates: First CLOSED candle closing outside support-tolerance or resistance+tolerance cancels qualification/active episode.
range_detector.activation: Only next candle OPEN AFTER fourth confirmed rejection, never retroactively on reference window.
range_detector.episode_dedup: Greedy chronological non-overlap per symbol+timeframe; qualification from one reference cannot run concurrently with another; after activation no overlap until breakout/expiry.
range_detector.stale_1h_regime: If fully closed 1h ADX is unavailable at reference end, no signal; never use unclosed 1h bar.
range_detector.falsification: Same detector must run on volatility/session-matched placebo walks and block-permuted development returns; synthetic unit results are NOT empirical market evidence.

roundtrip_includes: One round-trip amount for both fees and adverse slippage; 16bp descriptive reference, 20bp PRIMARY PROMOTION/DETECTOR DECISION.
entry: next completed bar OPEN after signal; no same-bar hindsight
gap: stop adverse fill at next bar OPEN when beyond stop; TP never gets a favorable gap improvement
funding_assumption: 1 bp / 8h for long; 0 for short, plus separate signed-funding sensitivity if data permits

promotion_checks: At least 300 closed trades over >=6 eligible months, per promoted symbol >=30, no one symbol >40% of pooled trades; report any symbol without evidence.
Pooled net mean >0 at DECISION COST 20bp on development and both chronological halves, and report holdout positive/inconclusive outcomes without model selection on holdout.
Pooled paired net_R/bp advantage vs matched random control >0; daily-block bootstrap lower 95% CI for DEVELOPMENT paired advantage >0, holdout advantage and CI reported ONCE.
rule_pool.evidence check_gate on trade and month groups with Bonferroni K=10 one-sided alpha=.05; raise K for any additional variants or cherry-picked symbol subset.
Portfolio risk/drawdown, gaps, correlation shock and schedule/slot execution cost acceptable, separate user approval always required.
turbo_prespec.random_control: same symbols, bar calendar, regime eligibility, side exposure, max_open3 and exits/costs, with deterministic pre-registered seeds; compare paired net R and bp; never re-randomize to select favorable result
turbo_prespec.initial_virtual_portfolio: independent Turbo research book max_open3 margin100 leverage20, no real account and no appropriation of Bull funds
turbo_prespec.integration_decision: Only after confirmed gates and separate approval: compare separate subaccount vs shared Bull via identical fill/risk engine; no auto move to Bull; 5+5 and 1500 USD are a future idea NOT APPROVED
turbo_prespec.familywise_k_reason: Conservative familywise correction for 8 earlier S4 pullback tests and 2 new frozen Turbo cooldown variants; if new hyperparams or symbol subsets are searched, increase K.
turbo_prespec.prior_exploration_disclosed: Claude's 9 Oct 2026 pullback 15m S4 BTC/ETH 2019–2026: eight prior variants, gross approx -1.8..+1.0bp, net around -16bp, none passed. Read from Claude, NOT recomputed here. Turbo 5m is a new timeframe hypothesis in the related family.
turbo_prespec.parameters_frozen: Unmodified desk.turbo_scalp.strategy.step with existing EMA20/50, slope lookback6, ATR stop1.2, TP1.5R, max hold24 bars, cooldown2 vs3. Never optimize on holdout.
confirmatory_stages: A: one locked DEVELOPMENT evaluation 2025-08-21..2026-08-20, no parameter tuning, chronological halves, paired control, empirical power.
B: exactly ONE sealed 60-day HOLDOUT evaluation after freeze; primary 20bp net and paired placebo; results cannot be reused to tune.
C: >=30 FUTURE days of zero-money shadow observation after user authorization, with data failures/latency/cost reported.
D: only then separate user-approved virtual-paper pilot max_open3. No automatic Bull sharing or 5+5/1500 change.
turbo_prespec.power_method: Report observed SD_net_bp and n_effective independent days/shock blocks. One-sided MDE_80pct=(NormalDist.inv_cdf(1-.05/K)+NormalDist.inv_cdf(.8))*SD/sqrt(n_effective). Raw n300/1000/3000 are NOT n_effective unless proven.

data_integrity_gate.source: Public historical OHLC only, canonical symbol and consistent market type; no trading/private API keys
data_integrity_gate.coverage_rule: Require >=99.5% of expected bars during known-open market sessions; signal and fill paths must be consecutive with NO missing bars; no interpolation.
data_integrity_gate.metal_hours_rule: For XAU/XAG respect published sessions/holidays; if unavailable mark UNKNOWN and exclude unreliable windows.
data_integrity_gate.no_holdout_lookahead: In sealed 60-day holdout inspect ONLY listing, timestamp continuity, duplicates/validity and availability; never OHLC distribution, edges, strategy or P&L metrics.
data_integrity_gate.minimum_history: 90 days 5m for diagnosis; >=6 eligible months for proposed promotion. Document unavailable markets.

net_captureable_move_after_costs.definition: Realized NET bp of trades causally generated only AFTER a valid four-touch range activation; never width or max(high)-min(low) using future prices.
net_captureable_move_after_costs.candidate_trigger: On support confirmed rejection propose LONG, on resistance confirmed rejection propose SHORT; fourth qualification confirmation itself can propose only from NEXT bar; no simultaneous opposite trades per symbol.
net_captureable_move_after_costs.entry: First eligible later OPEN with complete closed OHLC sequence via outcomes_v1_1.evaluate_candidate_path; missing bars UNRESOLVED/ineligible.
net_captureable_move_after_costs.take_profit: LONG frozen_resistance-tolerance; SHORT frozen_support+tolerance; skip if target/stop invalid relative to actual entry
net_captureable_move_after_costs.time_exit: Max 48 bars 5m or 16 bars 15m or earlier breakout/expiry, with precise forced-exit priority set in replay implementation before real data.
net_captureable_move_after_costs.execution: Stop first if both stop+TP in one OHLC; adverse gap at next OPEN; no positive gap target improvement; cost roundtrip once including slippage.
net_captureable_move_after_costs.metric: Mean actual net_bp across eligible post-activation closed trades, median net_bp, net_R, win fraction, net after 16bp report and 20bp decision costs; 95% block CI; report episode count and proportion with NO eligible entry as null not phantom zero.
net_captureable_move_after_costs.no_trade_if: stale or gapped, target invalid, missing book margin, no legal next open.

types: independent random walk with matched development volatility/session timetable, 200 replicates per symbol/timeframe
block-permuted past development returns preserving volatility/session regime, 200 replicates per symbol/timeframe
placebo_prereg.match: same market sessions, bars, symbol/timeframe, eligibility filters, entry/exit clock and costs; reconstruct valid OHLC and do not interpolate gaps
placebo_prereg.primary_comparison: paired per-symbol/regime real-minus-placebo episode-level mean NET-capture_bp at cost 20bp plus qualified episodes per eligible day
placebo_prereg.pass_condition: development paired net capture excess >0 with day-block 95% confidence lower bound>0 AND both chronological halves positive; otherwise reject range edge even if it finds many episodes
placebo_prereg.synthetic_local_only: 100 windows per class, forced favorable ADX=14: 0/100 random walk, 0/100 drift trend, 100/100 ideal sine oscillator qualify; NOT real-market evidence

selection_prereg: The future AI multistrategy selector is a separate statistical hypothesis and requires its own confirmatory testing/multiplicity budget.
